title: Additivity of the inner product in the first argument
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f, g, h : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be Boolean functions. With respect to the $L^2$ inner product under the uniform measure, $\langle f, g\rangle = 2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n} f(x)\,g(x)$, one has
\[
  \langle f + g,\, h\rangle \;=\; \langle f, h\rangle + \langle g, h\rangle,
\]
where $f + g$ denotes the pointwise sum.
hypotheses_covered: f, g, h are Boolean functions of arity n (real-valued functions on {0,1}^n)
replaced: $\langle f + g, h\rangle = \langle f, h\rangle + \langle g, h\rangle$.
